title: Senior AI Backend Engineer (Python/FastAPI)
description:
We are building LLM-powered products for recruiting teams and need a senior backend engineer to own our Python services.

Responsibilities:
- Design and operate async REST APIs in FastAPI.
- Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines on PostgreSQL with pgvector.
- Integrate LLM providers (OpenAI API, Anthropic API) with retries, timeouts and cost controls.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
- Must have: Python and FastAPI.
- Strong PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy skills; Docker and CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
- Experience with LLMs, embeddings and prompt engineering.
- Testing discipline with pytest.

Nice to have:
- Kubernetes, Terraform, Redis.
- Experience with Kafka or other event streaming is a plus.
